property_summary: After calling burn(10) as the owner on a contract with initialSupply 1000, the reference successfully executes, leaving owner unchanged as msg.sender, while the buggy version reverts, so c.owner() stays address(this) in both cases but the burn reverts in the bug; we check the boolean return of burn.
change_summary: Replace the require condition in onlyOwner to always fail (require false), making all onlyOwner functions revert, so owner stays unchanged after burn().
